title: Stability of planar fronts in reaction-diffusion systems
summary: A Lean formalization of effective dynamics near spectrally stable planar fronts in reaction-diffusion systems under small, bounded uniformly continuous perturbations. The main result constructs global solutions and approximates the perturbed front by a phase evolving according to a viscous Hamilton-Jacobi equation, with a uniform quantitative error bound.
